label: Town of Topsham
header:
# Town of Topsham municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 23; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a moderator for a one-year term
Town of Topsham, summary of the minutes of the town meeting of March 5, 2024 (town website): Henry Buermeyer was elected Moderator
Town of Topsham official website, Town Officials and Employees page: still names Henry Buermeyer as Moderator
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk

Town of Topsham, summary of the minutes of the town meeting of March 5, 2024 (town website): Karen Walker won the town clerk's three-year term by paper ballot, 79-29 over Kara Appleton, so the term runs into 2027
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Karen Walker as Topsham's Town Clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names Karen Walker as Topsham's Town Clerk
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer
Town of Topsham, summary of the minutes of the town meeting of March 5, 2024 (town website): Karen Walker holds the treasurer's three-year term won at the same 2024 meeting
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Karen Walker as Topsham's Town Treasurer
Town of Topsham official website, Town Officials and Employees page: names Jim Bulger, Tom Otterman, Carl Hildebrandt, Jake Thompson, and Brad Calhoun

Town of Topsham, summary of the minutes of the town meeting of March 5, 2024 (town website): James Bulger chairs the board; Tom Otterman and Brad Calhoun won their seats at the 2024 meeting (Calhoun by paper ballot, 58-52)
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect three listers on staggered three-year terms
Town of Topsham official website, Town Officials and Employees page: names Amelia Evans, John Hood, and Pam Langlitz as listers
Town of Topsham, summary of the minutes of the town meeting of March 5, 2024 (town website): Pam Langlitz won her lister seat at the 2024 meeting by paper ballot, 52-47
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect auditors (three, staggered terms) unless the office is eliminated
Town of Topsham official website, Town Officials and Employees page: names Peggy Welch and Nancy Frost as the town's auditors

Town of Topsham, summary of the minutes of the town meeting of March 5, 2024 (town website): the 2024 meeting drew no auditor nominations at all; Welch and Frost are seated on the current officials page's presentation of them as the town's auditors
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a constable
Town of Topsham official website, Town Officials and Employees page: lists David Mott as Constable among the town officers

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a collector of delinquent taxes); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership
Town of Topsham, summary of the minutes of the town meeting of March 5, 2024 (town website): Cynthia Flannigan won the one-year office in 2024; no current holder is published
